an1.140:1.1: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū adhammaṃ adhammo ti dīpenti te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an1.140:1.2: bahuñ ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti te c' imaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentī
